cast.Corsair: Adult woman; warm, grounded, direct. The player character.
cast.Mara: Adult woman; practical dockworker, warm with a rough edge.
cast.Crimson Raider: Adult raider; curt, defensive, no theatrical villain voice.
cast.Ivo: Adult watchkeeper; calm, low register, deliberate without theatrical gravity.
cast.Clerk: Older woman; precise, dry, confident, conversational pace.
cast.Vendor: Adult merchant; bright and lightly amused, never a caricature.
cast.Filing Cabinet: Neutral narrator; quiet observation, no character impersonation.
cast.Narrator: Neutral narrator; shares the filing cabinet voice.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.lookup_text: The tower's gone dark. I heard glass breaking in the clerk's office just now. Would you check on her? The door is beside the tower.
lines.spoken_text: The tower's gone dark. I heard glass breaking in the clerk's office just now. Would you check on her? The door is beside the tower.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.lookup_text: We've been paid, and the tower's burning again. I can see right across the quay from here.
lines.spoken_text: We've been paid, and the tower's burning again. I can see right across the quay from here.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.lookup_text: Let's get this back to the clerk. The others are still waiting to be paid.
lines.spoken_text: Let's get this back to the clerk. The others are still waiting to be paid.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.lookup_text: Let's find that pouch. The clerk will need every coin back.
lines.spoken_text: Let's find that pouch. The clerk will need every coin back.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.lookup_text: Stay close. I'll watch for anyone who needs help.
lines.spoken_text: Stay close. I'll watch for anyone who needs help.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.lookup_text: I'll meet you at the garden gate. Ivo will know where the thief went.
lines.spoken_text: I'll meet you at the garden gate. Ivo will know where the thief went.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.lookup_text: Is the clerk hurt?
lines.spoken_text: Is the clerk hurt?

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.lookup_text: The tower's burning again. Would you check on the clerk? I heard glass breaking in her office. The door is beside the tower.
lines.spoken_text: The tower's burning again. Would you check on the clerk? I heard glass breaking in her office. The door is beside the tower.

lines.speaker: Corsair
lines.lookup_text: I'll check on the clerk.
lines.spoken_text: I'll check on the clerk.

lines.speaker: Corsair
lines.lookup_text: She's safe. He stole the payroll. Will you come with me?
lines.spoken_text: She's safe. He stole the payroll. Will you come with me?

lines.speaker: Corsair
lines.lookup_text: What happened?
lines.spoken_text: What happened?

lines.speaker: Corsair
lines.lookup_text: Do you work here?
lines.spoken_text: Do you work here?

lines.speaker: Corsair
lines.lookup_text: Where is Ivo?
lines.spoken_text: Where is Ivo?

lines.speaker: Corsair
lines.lookup_text: Why is the tower dark?
lines.spoken_text: Why is the tower dark?

lines.speaker: Corsair
lines.lookup_text: Share a flask of lantern oil.
lines.spoken_text: Here. This should get the tower burning again.

lines.speaker: Corsair
lines.lookup_text: Keep the oil for the road.
lines.spoken_text: I need to keep the oil for the road.

lines.speaker: Corsair
lines.lookup_text: Leave conversation.
lines.spoken_text: Until next time.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.lookup_text: I'm coming. I mend dockhands as often as cargo nets. Tell Ivo we'll help him. If either of you gets hurt, stay close to me.
lines.spoken_text: I'm coming. I mend dockhands as often as cargo nets. Tell Ivo we'll help him. If either of you gets hurt, stay close to me.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.lookup_text: A crash from the office, then someone running across the court. I couldn't see who it was. Ivo went after them.
lines.spoken_text: A crash from the office, then someone running across the court. I couldn't see who it was. Ivo went after them.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.lookup_text: I unload the boats and tend the tower lamp at night. The clerk pays us on Fridays. I was waiting for my wages when I heard the crash.
lines.spoken_text: I unload the boats and tend the tower lamp at night. The clerk pays us on Fridays. I was waiting for my wages when I heard the crash.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.lookup_text: Thank you. Give me a moment to fill the reservoir. We should be able to see anyone else crossing the quay.
lines.spoken_text: Thank you. Give me a moment to fill the reservoir. We should be able to see anyone else crossing the quay.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.lookup_text: All right. Watch your footing by the water. Those boards are hard to see without the tower.
lines.spoken_text: All right. Watch your footing by the water. Those boards are hard to see without the tower.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.lookup_text: The reservoir ran dry. I was going to buy oil with tonight's pay. I should've fetched it before sunset.
lines.spoken_text: The reservoir ran dry. I was going to buy oil with tonight's pay. I should've fetched it before sunset.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.lookup_text: He ran east, towards the garden gate. It's the only way onto that terrace.
lines.spoken_text: He ran east, towards the garden gate. It's the only way onto that terrace.

lines.speaker: Ivo
lines.lookup_text: The man in red ran from the office into the garden. I've shut the gate behind him. There's no other way out, but he's got two mechanical guards.
lines.spoken_text: The man in red ran from the office into the garden. I've shut the gate behind him. There's no other way out, but he's got two mechanical guards.

lines.speaker: Ivo
lines.lookup_text: The tower's lit again. I'll stay with the prisoner until the watch arrives.
lines.spoken_text: The tower's lit again. I'll stay with the prisoner until the watch arrives.

lines.speaker: Ivo
lines.lookup_text: Take the money back to the clerk. I'll stay with the prisoner until the watch arrives.
lines.spoken_text: Take the money back to the clerk. I'll stay with the prisoner until the watch arrives.

lines.speaker: Ivo
lines.lookup_text: The guards are down. Check the raider for the payroll; I'll keep watch.
lines.spoken_text: The guards are down. Check the raider for the payroll; I'll keep watch.

lines.speaker: Ivo
lines.lookup_text: Mara stays behind us. Keep the guards busy while we close on the thief.
lines.spoken_text: Mara stays behind us. Keep the guards busy while we close on the thief.

lines.speaker: Corsair
lines.lookup_text: Mara's ready. Let's get the payroll back.
lines.spoken_text: Mara's ready. Let's get the payroll back.

lines.speaker: Corsair
lines.lookup_text: Why haven't you gone in?
lines.spoken_text: Why haven't you gone in?

lines.speaker: Corsair
lines.lookup_text: What are those machines?
lines.spoken_text: What are those machines?

lines.speaker: Ivo
lines.lookup_text: I'll lift the chain. Stay together. Those guards hit hard, and Mara needs room to work.
lines.spoken_text: I'll lift the chain. Stay together. Those guards hit hard, and Mara needs room to work.

lines.speaker: Ivo
lines.lookup_text:
One of his guards nearly took my head off. I couldn't fight both at once. Get Mara.

We'll need someone who can tend a wound.
lines.spoken_text:
One of his guards nearly took my head off. I couldn't fight both at once. Get Mara.

We'll need someone who can tend a wound.

lines.speaker: Ivo
lines.lookup_text: They're the raider's guards. He gives the orders; they do the fighting. Don't let them surround us.
lines.spoken_text: They're the raider's guards. He gives the orders; they do the fighting. Don't let them surround us.

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.lookup_text: I'm all right. He shoved past me and smashed the lock off the payroll chest. I couldn't even see his face until he was through the door.
lines.spoken_text: I'm all right. He shoved past me and smashed the lock off the payroll chest. I couldn't even see his face until he was through the door.

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.lookup_text: I've counted it twice. Nobody will lose their wages. We'll have that lock replaced in the morning.
lines.spoken_text: I've counted it twice. Nobody will lose their wages. We'll have that lock replaced in the morning.

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.lookup_text: That pouch has the quay stamp on it. You found him! Let me count the money.
lines.spoken_text: That pouch has the quay stamp on it. You found him! Let me count the money.

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.lookup_text: Did you find the money? We can't pay anyone until it comes back.
lines.spoken_text: Did you find the money? We can't pay anyone until it comes back.

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.lookup_text: Keep each other safe. I'll stay here in case the watch comes.
lines.spoken_text: Keep each other safe. I'll stay here in case the watch comes.

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.lookup_text: Mara was waiting for her pay outside. Tell her I'm safe. Ivo chased the thief east, towards the garden.
lines.spoken_text: Mara was waiting for her pay outside. Tell her I'm safe. Ivo chased the thief east, towards the garden.

lines.speaker: Corsair
lines.lookup_text: Who was he? What did he take?
lines.spoken_text: Who was he? What did he take?

lines.speaker: Corsair
lines.lookup_text: Return the stolen payroll.
lines.spoken_text: Here is the stolen payroll.

lines.speaker: Corsair
lines.lookup_text: Could I use the market side passage?
lines.spoken_text: Could I use the market side passage?

lines.speaker: Corsair
lines.lookup_text: May I look through the harbor archive?
lines.spoken_text: May I look through the harbor archive?

lines.speaker: Corsair
lines.lookup_text: Do robberies happen often here?
lines.spoken_text: Do robberies happen often here?

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.lookup_text: I'll leave the side door unlatched. It cuts from this court to the market.
lines.spoken_text: I'll leave the side door unlatched. It cuts from this court to the market.

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.lookup_text: The cabinet over there holds the harbor history. You can take the visitor's copy. Thankfully the thief wasn't interested in books.
lines.spoken_text: The cabinet over there holds the harbor history. You can take the visitor's copy. Thankfully the thief wasn't interested in books.

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.lookup_text: Pickpockets, sometimes. Armed robbery in my office? Never. With the tower out he got across the court before I saw him coming.
lines.spoken_text: Pickpockets, sometimes. Armed robbery in my office? Never. With the tower out he got across the court before I saw him coming.

lines.speaker: Filing Cabinet
lines.lookup_text: A visitor's copy of the harbor history lies in the bottom drawer.
lines.spoken_text: A visitor's copy of the harbor history lies in the bottom drawer.

lines.speaker: Filing Cabinet
lines.lookup_text: You already have the visitor's copy. The remaining volumes belong in the archive.
lines.spoken_text: You already have the visitor's copy. The remaining volumes belong in the archive.

lines.speaker: Corsair
lines.lookup_text: Take the harbor history.
lines.spoken_text: A history of the harbor. I'll take a look.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.lookup_text: The booklet describes the building of Lantern Quay and the little garden planted above its eastern sea wall.
lines.spoken_text: The booklet describes the building of Lantern Quay and the little garden planted above its eastern sea wall.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.lookup_text: You close the drawer.
lines.spoken_text: You close the drawer.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.lookup_text: Silver coins and folded wage slips fill the pouch. The clerk can account for them.
lines.spoken_text: Silver coins and folded wage slips fill the pouch. The clerk can account for them.

lines.speaker: Vendor
lines.lookup_text: Fresh rope, dry matches, and a map that has never met the tide.
lines.spoken_text: Fresh rope, dry matches, and a map that has never met the tide.

lines.speaker: Vendor
lines.lookup_text: Good to see the tower burning again. Mind your step on the bridge.
lines.spoken_text: Good to see the tower burning again. Mind your step on the bridge.

lines.speaker: Corsair
lines.lookup_text: Ask for directions through town.
lines.spoken_text: Can you point me through town?

lines.speaker: Corsair
lines.lookup_text: Ask about the lantern tower.
lines.spoken_text: What can you tell me about the lantern tower?

lines.speaker: Vendor
lines.lookup_text: The market is west, the clerk's office is by the northern tower, and the garden is east.
lines.spoken_text: The market is west, the clerk's office is by the northern tower, and the garden is east.

lines.speaker: Vendor
lines.lookup_text: Mara tends it after the last boat unloads. When it burns, you can see clear from my stall to the garden gate.
lines.spoken_text: Mara tends it after the last boat unloads. When it burns, you can see clear from my stall to the garden gate.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.lookup_text: Thank you. I'll stay here in case someone else needs help. Call if she's hurt.
lines.spoken_text: Thank you. I'll stay here in case someone else needs help. Call if she's hurt.

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.lookup_text: A man in a red coat, with two iron guards behind him. He emptied the chest into a pouch and ran east. That's the dockworkers' pay. Tell Mara what happened, then find Ivo. He went after the thief.
lines.spoken_text: A man in a red coat, with two iron guards behind him. He emptied the chest into a pouch and ran east. That's the dockworkers' pay. Tell Mara what happened, then find Ivo. He went after the thief.

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.lookup_text: The whole payroll. Thank you. Mara, here's your week's wages. Buy the tower oil before anything else; I don't want another night like this.
lines.spoken_text: The whole payroll. Thank you. Mara, here's your week's wages. Buy the tower oil before anything else; I don't want another night like this.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.lookup_text: The raider is down. A heavy pouch hangs from his belt, stamped with the quay's mark.
lines.spoken_text: The raider is down. A heavy pouch hangs from his belt, stamped with the quay's mark.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.lookup_text: The chest has been forced open. Its broken lock lies on the floor. Scraps of wage envelopes are all that's left inside.
lines.spoken_text: The chest has been forced open. Its broken lock lies on the floor. Scraps of wage envelopes are all that's left inside.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.lookup_text: The recovered payroll is back in the chest. The broken lock still needs replacing.
lines.spoken_text: The recovered payroll is back in the chest. The broken lock still needs replacing.

lines.speaker: Ivo
lines.lookup_text: There he is. The payroll pouch is on his belt.
lines.spoken_text: There he is. The payroll pouch is on his belt.

lines.speaker: Corsair
lines.lookup_text: Give us the money. You have nowhere to go.
lines.spoken_text: Give us the money. You have nowhere to go.

lines.speaker: Crimson Raider
lines.lookup_text: Then you should have stayed outside. Guards!
lines.spoken_text: Then you should have stayed outside. Guards!

lines.speaker: Ivo
lines.lookup_text: I'll hold him here. Take the payroll back to the clerk.
lines.spoken_text: I'll hold him here. Take the payroll back to the clerk.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.lookup_text: Let's get everyone paid.
lines.spoken_text: Let's get everyone paid.

lines.speaker: Crimson Raider
lines.lookup_text: I surrender! Take the payroll pouch. Just call them off.
lines.spoken_text: I surrender! Take the payroll pouch. Just call them off.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.lookup_text: The tower's gone out. I was waiting for my pay to buy more oil.
lines.spoken_text: The tower's gone out. I was waiting for my pay to buy more oil.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.lookup_text: Did you hear that? Glass breaking, over at the clerk's office.
lines.spoken_text: Did you hear that? Glass breaking, over at the clerk's office.

lines.speaker: Corsair
lines.lookup_text: I'll check on her. Stay here.
lines.spoken_text: I'll check on her. Stay here.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.lookup_text: There's enough oil now to keep the tower burning till morning.
lines.spoken_text: There's enough oil now to keep the tower burning till morning.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.lookup_text: I can see every plank again. Thank you for coming back with me.
lines.spoken_text: I can see every plank again. Thank you for coming back with me.

lines.speaker: Mara
lines.lookup_text: Your oil kept the tower burning while we were gone. I've bought enough for the rest of the night.
lines.spoken_text: Your oil kept the tower burning while we were gone. I've bought enough for the rest of the night.
